$jsonSchema.title: journey_stories
$jsonSchema.description: Fitness journey timeline: post-workout journals and progress photos. Attributes are sparse and evolve over time (mood, energy, tags, photo angle, free text), so a flexible document fits better than a wide table of NULLs. Extra fields are allowed on purpose.

user_id.description: users.id in MySQL (cross-store reference, checked by the API)

date.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time

session_id.description: workout_sessions.id in MySQL when the story is about a workout

highlights.description: Free-form highlight objects, e.g. PRs hit in the session
